classReports.title: Class Report - 18 Aug 2026
classReports.summary: This lesson connected Italo’s maritime studies and career plans with practical English for professional interviews. He discussed companies and vessels, his training, onboard routines, offshore and onshore work, dynamic positioning systems and renewable energy. He also practiced presenting his professional profile, experience and career interests in English.

classReports.teacherInsight: Italo used his technical knowledge as a foundation for meaningful professional communication and practiced turning it into clearer interview-style English.

grammarOverview.title: Grammar & Accuracy Overview
grammarOverview.summary: Current priorities are high-value grammar patterns that support clearer professional communication.
focusPoints: Verb patterns: use start + verb-ing / to + verb; want + to + verb; need + to + verb in professional answers.
Agreement & wording: use singular agreement consistently and choose precise professional wording, e.g. Each company has its own interview process.
Time reference: use Present Simple for recurring conditions, Present Continuous for what is happening now, and will for future schedules or plans.

teacherFeedback.title: General Feedback
teacherFeedback.body: Italo brings valuable technical knowledge to class and can discuss complex maritime subjects when the language is connected to situations he understands well. He is willing to communicate and is beginning to use English more actively outside class.

teacherFeedback.title: Growth Priority
teacherFeedback.body: Use familiar maritime content to make professional answers more structured, grammatically accurate and confident before adding large amounts of new technical terminology.
